authorship: Authored working playbooks and blank templates; not completed institutional evidence.

packs.title: Commercial bank technology and service operations
packs.scope: Nepal commercial-bank technology assessment; not credit decisions, a completed IS audit or a regulatory compliance opinion.

workflows.title: Service and branch dependency mapping
workflows.decision: Which customer services must survive a branch or provider outage?
workflows.evidence: Service hours, channels, branch dependencies, owners and observed outage records.
workflows.deliverable: Service-to-system/site/provider dependency map and business-impact assessment.
workflows.acceptance: Business owners confirm dependencies and approve service-specific recovery objectives.

workflows.title: Access and transaction integrity
workflows.decision: Who can initiate, approve, change and reconcile a sensitive transaction?
workflows.evidence: Role permissions, joiner/leaver records, privileged accounts, approval paths and exception records; use redacted or synthetic samples.
workflows.deliverable: Access/segregation matrix and review exceptions.
workflows.acceptance: Demonstrate permitted and prohibited actions in an authorized test environment; reconcile an approved test transaction.

workflows.title: Continuity and recovery exercise
workflows.decision: Can the service recover within owner-approved data-loss and time limits?
workflows.evidence: Backup/replication configuration, restore evidence, recovery dependencies and actual exercise timestamps.
workflows.deliverable: Recovery scenario, exercise log, measured recovery gap and remediation ownership.
workflows.acceptance: Recover a representative service safely in an isolated or explicitly approved exercise and compare measured results with targets.

workflows.title: Supplier and outsourced service assurance
workflows.decision: What happens if the platform or connectivity supplier fails or changes?
workflows.evidence: Service scope, subcontractors, data access/location, support escalation, contract evidence and exit dependencies.
workflows.deliverable: Supplier due-diligence/exit matrix linked to service criticality.
workflows.acceptance: Walk through an outage and termination/export scenario with accountable owners; unsupported supplier claims remain open.

workflows.title: System change and migration
workflows.decision: Can a release or migration preserve records and allow recovery?
workflows.evidence: Source/target mappings, reconciliation totals, test results, approvals and rollback dependencies.
workflows.deliverable: Change record, reconciliation tests and go/no-go criteria.
workflows.acceptance: Test duplicates, rejected records, rollback and reconciled totals before authorized release.

workflows.title: Regulatory and audit evidence
workflows.decision: Which current instrument and exact provision apply to this bank and service?
workflows.evidence: Original NRB documents, applicable later directives/circulars, bank policies and independent review.
workflows.deliverable: Provision-to-control-to-evidence mapping with applicability and amendment fields.
workflows.acceptance: The bank risk/compliance reviewer resolves current applicability; the toolkit never marks a bank compliant automatically.

packs.title: Small technology shop: sales, repair and support
packs.scope: Nepal technology retail/repair operating workflow. No invented stock, prices, margins, warranties, tax rates or customers.

workflows.title: Enquiry to comparable offer
workflows.decision: What problem, configuration and support does the buyer actually need?
workflows.evidence: Use case, budget authority, exact SKU/configuration, dated supplier evidence and included/excluded services.
workflows.deliverable: Requirements-to-offer comparison and quotation assumptions.
workflows.acceptance: Buyer requirements map to the exact offered configuration; price validity and support exclusions are explicit.

workflows.title: Purchase and stock receipt
workflows.decision: Did the shop receive the expected, traceable configuration?
workflows.evidence: Purchase reference, quantities, exact variants, serial records where appropriate and physical condition.
workflows.deliverable: Stock/serial receipt and discrepancy log.
workflows.acceptance: Count and configuration reconcile with receipt evidence; discrepant units are not silently sold as verified.

workflows.title: Repair intake and device custody
workflows.decision: What work and data access did the customer authorize?
workflows.evidence: Device condition, fault description, accessories, consent scope and custody handovers; keep identifiers private.
workflows.deliverable: Repair job, authorization and custody record.
workflows.acceptance: Technician work stays inside authorization; return condition, accessories and agreed tests are recorded.

workflows.title: Job and unit economics
workflows.decision: Does the sale or repair cover its actual acquisition and delivery obligations?
workflows.evidence: Dated purchase cost, labour time/cost basis, transport, returns, warranty reserve assumptions and consistent tax treatment.
workflows.deliverable: Cost worksheet separating observed amounts from estimates.
workflows.acceptance: Every amount has currency, unit and evidence/assumption basis; unknowns are not replaced with made-up margins.

workflows.title: Warranty and after-sales
workflows.decision: Who is responsible when a sold device or repair fails?
workflows.evidence: Exact warranty document, supplier route, exclusions, service history and promised response.
workflows.deliverable: Warranty/support case and supplier escalation log.
workflows.acceptance: A test support case reaches the responsible role; promises match actual documented coverage.

workflows.title: Records, backup and owner review
workflows.decision: Can the owner reconcile stock, jobs, receipts and essential records?
workflows.evidence: Opening/closing balances, sales/return/job records, access ownership and restore test.
workflows.deliverable: Daily reconciliation, exception queue and recovery instructions.
workflows.acceptance: A sample sale, return and repair reconcile across records; an essential backup is restored successfully.

packs.title: School and college technology: teaching through maintenance
packs.scope: Nepal school/college technology assessment. Institution, funding and procurement stages need verification; equipment purchase is not proof of learning improvement.

workflows.title: Teaching need and baseline
workflows.decision: Which lesson or administrative task needs improvement?
workflows.evidence: Teacher workflow, existing equipment/use, class context and accessibility barriers; avoid identifiable student records.
workflows.deliverable: Problem statement, baseline and alternatives including non-purchase options.
workflows.acceptance: Teachers can explain the intended use and observable success criteria before a product is selected.

workflows.title: Room, power and connectivity readiness
workflows.decision: Can the equipment be installed and used safely and reliably?
workflows.evidence: Room layout, sightlines, acoustics, mounting, measured load conditions and connectivity; competent personnel for safety assessment.
workflows.deliverable: Site survey and unresolved readiness risks.
workflows.acceptance: Demonstrate visibility, sound and intended interaction under actual room conditions; address safety issues before installation.

workflows.title: Funding and procurement evidence
workflows.decision: Is this an idea, allocation, released funding or an actual purchase process?
workflows.evidence: Actual institution identity, budget/notice, approval authority, applicable process and amendments.
workflows.deliverable: Evidence-stage register and specification/offer matrix.
workflows.acceptance: Every funding/procurement status points to its own dated document; no jump from announcement to confirmed purchase.

workflows.title: Content, software and student data
workflows.decision: Are content rights, accessibility and data handling appropriate?
workflows.evidence: Licence terms, renewal cost, language/accessibility needs, account roles and any data collection/sharing.
workflows.deliverable: Licence/data/access register and renewal responsibilities.
workflows.acceptance: Test intended lesson content and access boundaries; resolve unsupported permissions and hidden renewals.

workflows.title: Training and acceptance
workflows.decision: Can teachers operate the delivered system in their workflow?
workflows.evidence: Agreed tasks, training time, support materials, actual equipment configuration and installation tests.
workflows.deliverable: Teacher task demonstration, installation acceptance and support handover.
workflows.acceptance: Representative operators deliver an agreed task and recover from a common problem without installer assistance.

workflows.title: Use and outcome follow-up
workflows.decision: Is the system used, and what does the evidence say about outcomes?
workflows.evidence: Usage definitions, baseline/follow-up periods, downtime, support events and limitations of comparison.
workflows.deliverable: Usage/maintenance review separating association from causal learning claims.
workflows.acceptance: Reported results preserve periods, denominators, missingness and study-design limits.

packs.title: Student and professional researcher: protocol to reproducible report
packs.scope: Nepal technology-business research across quantitative, qualitative, engineering and mixed-method questions. Adapt to the discipline and institutional requirements; no universal research validity claim.

workflows.title: Question and literature gap
workflows.decision: What answerable question is missing, and for whom does it matter?
workflows.evidence: Original studies, definitions, scope, dates, methods and conflicting findings.
workflows.deliverable: Literature/evidence matrix and bounded research question.
workflows.acceptance: A reviewer can trace the gap to the cited work; a topic list is not presented as a literature review.

workflows.title: Design and sampling
workflows.decision: Which design can answer the question without unsupported extrapolation?
workflows.evidence: Target population, frame, inclusion rules, selection, feasibility, confounders and missing-data plan.
workflows.deliverable: Protocol and justified sampling/analysis plan.
workflows.acceptance: The design matches descriptive, comparative or causal claims; convenience samples are not labelled Nepal-representative.

workflows.title: Ethics, permissions and collection
workflows.decision: What may be collected, and how are participants or confidential systems protected?
workflows.evidence: Institutional requirements, required consent/permissions, minimization, retention and access roles.
workflows.deliverable: Permission/ethics decision and collection instrument.
workflows.acceptance: Required approvals precede relevant collection; public artifacts omit identifiable/confidential records.

workflows.title: Data provenance and analysis
workflows.decision: Can another researcher reproduce the transformations?
workflows.evidence: Source editions, raw-to-derived mapping, units, calendars, code versions, exclusions and analysis logs.
workflows.deliverable: Data dictionary, transformation log and executable analysis references.
workflows.acceptance: Re-run on authorized data and reconcile output; distinguish unavailable data from zero.

workflows.title: Robustness and interpretation
workflows.decision: Could selection, definitions or another explanation change the result?
workflows.evidence: Missingness, sensitivity checks, contradictions, uncertainty and alternative explanations.
workflows.deliverable: Robustness review and claims-to-evidence ledger.
workflows.acceptance: Conclusions remain bounded by evidence/design; unresolved contradictions stay visible.

workflows.title: Writing, review and dissemination
workflows.decision: Can readers distinguish methods, results and interpretation?
workflows.evidence: Claim citations/locators, institution format, reviewer comments, rights and reproducibility limits.
workflows.deliverable: Report, bibliography, reproducibility checklist and correction record.
workflows.acceptance: Supervisor/subject reviewer can trace material claims and methods; AI checks are not described as peer review.
